lines.l: Oh, the cottonwood trees, they send me off forever, but I ask you please, don't fix me, just turn me loose, let me straddle my old saddle underneath the western skies.
Oh, my Cajus, let me wander over yonder
Till I see the mountain ride
I want to ride to the ridge where the west hole misses
And gaze at the moon until I lose my senses
I can't look at hobbles and I can't stand fences
